integration_notes:
SECRET NAMES: deploy.yml uses the names from the task: environment `production` secrets VPS_HOST, VPS_USER and VPS_SSH_KEY, plus an optional VPS_KNOWN_HOSTS (without it the job trusts the host key on first use and warns), and the environment variable PLOTINIUM_DOMAIN. specs/14-devops/deployment-and-ci.md §3.9 still names them DEPLOY_SSH_KEY, DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS, DEPLOY_HOST and DEPLOY_USER; the spec table should be updated to match.

RELEASE.YML DESIGN, where it differs from spec §3.7.5:
(1) It builds and pushes all three images, web, app and db, not only web and app, because ops/deploy.sh and compose.prod.yaml need PLOTINIUM_DB_IMAGE from images.lock.json.
(2) ci.yml has no `workflow_call` trigger, so release.yml runs its own suite job. Adding workflow_call to ci.yml would let the release reuse it.
(3) tools/traceability.ts has no `--gate`/`--tag` mode yet, so the release uses `--strict --json` and `--out`.
(4) The perf job looks for a successful perf-lab.yml run on main with the same git tree, at most 7 days old, and downloads its artifact named `perf-results` for check-budgets `--cadence release --machine lab-spec`. It fails only when the variable REQUIRE_LAB_PERF=true. perf-lab.yml must upload `perf-results` in the tests/performance result format.
(5) The bring-up gates on clone → `up --wait` → `/` and `/api/readyz` serving within 240 s. There is a TODO to add Playwright desktop-interactive once `tests/bringup/` exists.
(6) The pin job rewrites compose.yaml image lines with a regex that accepts any owner, so it also replaces the placeholder `ghcr.io/plotinium-org/...:0.1.0`. PRs opened with GITHUB_TOKEN do not start CI, so a member closes and reopens the pin PR once; the repository setting 'Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests' must be enabled.
(7) The deploy job calls deploy.yml through workflow_call with `secrets: inherit`. It can be skipped with the variable DEPLOY_ON_RELEASE=false.
(8) Optional variables: ARM64_RUNNER (set to ubuntu-24.04 on a private repository to build arm64 under a digest-pinned QEMU), WEB_BUILD, PLT_SEMESTER_START, BRINGUP_ALLOW_DOCKER_HUB.
(9) Action SHAs were resolved with git ls-remote. New pins: docker/setup-buildx-action v4.4.1, build-push-action v7.4.0, setup-qemu-action v4.4.0, actions/download-artifact v8.0.1. BuildKit and binfmt images are pinned by digest.

DEPLOY.SH (owned by another agent), suggested changes:
(a) It downloads images.lock.json anonymously from the public release URL, which fails on a private repository. Suggest accepting a pre-staged file or a token.
(b) Its own `git checkout --detach <tag>` rewrites the script while bash is still running it. deploy.yml avoids this by checking out the tag on the VPS first, but a re-exec after checkout would make the script safe on its own.
(c) The pre-deploy backup needs RCLONE_REMOTE and RCLONE_CONFIG. deploy.yml sources /etc/plotinium/backup.env, which cloud-init installs.
(d) Staging needs compose.staging.yaml, which is still a TODO.
